title: SSH/service brute force runner via Hydra: cover AutoPenBench AC0 weak-password task
goal: AutoPenBench AC0 task requires brute forcing SSH with a weak password list — AegisPT has no Hydra/SSH brute force runner. The existing credential-attacks runner only does Kerberos/AD attacks. Implement an ssh-brute runner using Hydra: (1) Takes configured target host(s) and port. (2) Uses a tiered wordlist: first try the top-50 most common passwords (admin, password, 123456, root, toor, etc.), then the engagement-configured password list if provided. (3) For each discovered service from nmap (SSH/21/23/3389/FTP/SMB), attempt authentication. (4) Rate-limited: max 5 attempts per second, stops after 3 consecutive lockouts detected. (5) Reports any successful credential pair as a Critical finding: 'Weak Credential: SSH root:password on 10.0.0.1:22'. (6) Integrates into assessment chain Phase 2 (active-enrichment) for LAN assessments. (7) Also supports FTP, Telnet, RDP basic brute force with same wordlist. Install Hydra via install_security_tools.sh. Active tier — requires approval. Covers AutoPenBench AC0 exactly. WIZARD WIRING (mandatory): (1) Add to api/app/services/run_profiles.py: name=active-lan-ssh-brute, run_class=ACTIVE, tools=[ssh-brute], required_approvals=1, approval_step_id: active-lan-ssh-brute. (2) Add profile active-lan-ssh-brute to FULL-INTERNAL-LAN Phase 2 and FULL-LAN-IOT Phase 4 in api/app/services/assessment_chain.py. (3) Add to wizard.js resolveExecutionProfile: when Internal LAN or AD or Full Internal tile + active or full, include active-lan-ssh-brute in planned profiles. (4) Add to scripts/acceptance_harness.py PROFILE_TOOL_MAP: active-lan-ssh-brute: [ssh-brute].
scope: AutoPenBench AC0 (Sudo weak passwords) 20% autonomous / 80% assisted success. AegisPT has no SSH brute force. Code audit confirmed: credential-attacks uses kerbrute only (AD), no Hydra, no SSH brute force. Hydra not in install_security_tools.sh.
